updates.summary: Added note that zero-copy pipelines drain to completion and do not break early on error (cross-reference FR-054).

Rewrote to pin-safe eviction via evict_one_clean over a widening scan; removed blind-LRU/evict_lru_for_key data-loss fallback; AllocationFailed when all candidates pinned; target_key unused; evict_and_insert fragmentation relief pin-safe.
Added cold_staging_slots (default 64) and cold_staging_buf_bytes (default 4 MiB) config fields; 0 slots disables staging.
AtomicU64 warm_stream is now a fallback; warm/D2H paths use per-device streams from DEVICE_STREAMS (cross-reference FR-052).
Concurrent-promotion-race recovery: AlreadyExists on a lost mt.insert race served warm from the winner's resident slot after a bounded wait.
Per-GPU-device CUDA stream routing (DEVICE_STREAMS/device_streams_for/set_batch_device/ColdReadRequest.gpu_device) for multi-GPU / tensor-parallel.
Bounded cold-load staging pool (StagingPool/StagingLease) serves cold reads uncached when the tier is saturated instead of failing AllocationFailed.
Cold-read drain-to-completion: pipelines drain until completed==submitted using stop_submitting, never breaking early.
Concurrent batch_lookup promotions of the same cold key both succeed (loser served the winner's data).
